name: hb-peiteng-website
description: Webseite Handball Club vun der Gemeng Péiteng

scripts.test: python3 -I tests/test_import.py && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/live.check.ts && node tests/pages-base.check.mjs
scripts.deploy: astro build && node scripts/pages-base.mjs /hb-peiteng-website && cd dist && rm -rf .git && git init -q -b gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -qm "Mise en ligne" && git push -qf "$(git -C .. remote get-url origin)" gh-pages
